frontiers.purpose: Prove that catalog publication, open, lookup, sync, fsck, and collection remain sharded and bounded-memory at roughly two billion 256 KiB chunks; payload materialization is not required for catalog-only runs.
frontiers.title: 500 TB physical repository

frontiers.purpose: Exercise sustained ingest, clone, verification, compaction, collection, and cold restoration against bytes that cannot be compressed away.
frontiers.title: 30 GiB physical repository

frontiers.purpose: Expose per-object metadata, lookup, traversal, publication, and backend-request amplification independently of payload bytes.
frontiers.title: 10 million objects

frontiers.purpose: Stress very wide trees, checkout, directory encoding, query, and lazy workspace behavior.
frontiers.title: 5 million paths

frontiers.purpose: Measure deep-history traversal, reachability, commit graphs, incremental import, and retention metadata.
frontiers.title: 1 million revisions

frontiers.purpose: Measure manifest, MIDX, WAL replay, compaction debt, startup, and point-lookup degradation.
frontiers.title: 10,000 incremental generations

frontiers.purpose: Prove that unchanged import, warm sync, incremental fetch, and indexing follow the delta instead of total retained state.
frontiers.title: 0.001% incremental change

frontiers.purpose: Exercise spill, streaming, pack resolution, verification, and collection while total repository state is much larger than RAM.
frontiers.title: 1 GiB process budget

frontiers.purpose: Restore a serving node from authoritative object storage and indexes, then verify time to first correct read and full readiness.
frontiers.title: Cold node restoration

principles: Correctness is a gate for every successful performance sample
Scaling curves matter more than isolated fastest points
Incremental work should track the delta rather than all retained state
Peak memory and backend request amplification must be explicit
Tail latency, contention, restart, and failure paths are first-class
Raw results and environment identity remain authoritative

profiles.purpose: Fast correctness and gross-regression coverage on every change
Scaling curves, backend matrices, and contention
Pinned reproducible results used for public claims
Manual cliff finding at production-scale limits
